method: whole-bridge coherence gamma2 = |sum(z)|^2/(N*sum(|z|^2)) over the masked bridge-deck echo (intensity >= peak_frac*peak AND >= median_mult*median). Whole bridge pooled per window AND per-burst stitched (3 girder windows merged); per girder grouped by the persisted FEM baseline.
per_girder_refused: per-girder block refused: no asset/date group carries more than one distinct window payload (0 of 1454 groups) — every segment holds the same chip, so a per-girder comparison would be a self-comparison. Fix: give the girders their own coordinates and re-extract (`cargo run --release --bin reextract_carola_segments -- --name-like 'Carola%' --from 2023-09-01 --to 2025-09-30 --wipe --yes`).
